name: quake
summary: Quake (1996) — id Software's software-rendered engine + shareware episode 1 data (WinQuake subset, GPL v2)

quake.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Quake resolves its data (./id1/pak0.pak) and writes config.cfg relative
# to the CWD (sys_sdl.c basedir "."), so cd to wherever this package
# actually lives — the cd is load-bearing, do not drop it. Self-location
# is a known-prefix probe (todos/0444): /opt/quake installed, /usr/opt/quake
# baked (fat image); cd is a hush builtin — zero spawns (the old
# dirname-of-realpath command substitution cost four processes per launch).
# Variable-free by design (#296): builtins and literal paths only. The
# launcher stays the game's waiting parent (no exec) — job control and the
# e2e's pkill contract rely on that.
cd /opt/quake 2>/dev/null || cd /usr/opt/quake || exit 127
./quake-bin "$@"
